title: Wingbox evidence record, version 2
description: What one run of the Wingbox pull request check looked at and found. Written as wingbox-evidence.json beside the report and the review plan.

generated.description: UTC time the record was written.

ref.description: The tag, branch or commit of the action that ran; empty when not known.

wingbox.description: The Wingbox release that built the graph.

change.description: The number of the pull or merge request; empty outside one.

attempt.description: The attempt of the run (GitHub: a re-run has the same id and the next attempt); empty when the system has none.

job.description: The job of the run that ran the check; empty when not known.

head.description: The head commit named, or working-tree.

checked.description: The commit of the files that were analysed; empty for a working directory.

tree.description: How the commit checked relates to the head: the head itself, its merge into the base, another commit.

differs.description: Files of the working folder that were not as in the commit checked.

files.description: The changed files the commit checked holds, each with the SHA-256 of its content in that commit.

evidence.description: none: no test report was given. none-found: reports were given, no test that uses what changed was found and none is required: the reports say nothing about this change. failed: a test to run or a required test has a failed case. incomplete: one has a case that was skipped or did not run, or no record, or the manifest of required tests could not be read. complete: every recorded case of every test to run and of every required test passed.

status.description: passed: every recorded case passed. failed: a case failed. partial: a case passed and another was skipped or did not run. skipped: no case passed. no-record: the reports hold no case of it. none: no test report was given.

cases.description: The recorded cases that belong to the test.

records.description: Each of those cases, then the test functions of the file that no report names (Go).

where.description: Where the report puts the case: its class name, else its file, else its suite.

required.description: The tests the manifest of required tests names for this change, whatever the graph found.

group.description: The group of the manifest that names the test.

test.description: A test file, or <file, class or Go folder>::<case>.

manifest.description: The manifest of required tests as it was read.

path.description: From the root of the repository; empty when the repository has none.

source.description: base: read from the base commit. head: only the checked files hold it. none: there is none.

commit.description: The base commit it was read from; empty otherwise.

sha256.description: Of the bytes of the manifest; empty when there is none.

errors.description: Why the manifest was refused; what the change must pass is then not known.

provenance.description: What the job knows of itself, the test reports were judged by.

commit.description: The commit checked; empty for a working directory.

started.description: The start of the run as the job knows it, UTC; empty when not known. GitHub: the start of the job. GitLab: the creation of the pipeline.

run.description: The run a sidecar must name (GitHub: the run id; GitLab: the pipeline id); empty when not known.

command.description: The test command the job states (input test-command), verbatim.

sidecar-required.description: Whether a report without a sidecar is refused (input require-test-provenance).

status.description: refused: the report does not count as evidence; its cases were left out.

timestamp.description: The earliest timestamp a suite of the report states, as written; empty when it states none.

modified.description: The modification time of the file, UTC.

tracked.description: Whether git tracks the file; unknown outside a git work tree.

commits.description: The commits the report names in a property or an attribute.

sidecar.description: The state of <report>.run.json beside the report.

sidecar-command.description: The test command the sidecar states.

documents.description: The files written beside the record, each with the SHA-256 of its text.
